page.overview:
Who is Shito?

Shito is of tall stature with a burly build. He has short-cut black hair with a lock of hair on his forehead and also possesses black-pupiled eyes and white sclera. He wears a scientist uniform made up of a piece of the strapless version of combat armor on his chest over a high-collar white long-sleeved gown.

Together with Moroko and Nion, Shito discusses the power of Broly and Vegeta IV with King Vegeta.
